=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text data "7 -3 12 0 7 4 -3 9 15 1 -5 4 12 0 8"
global vals long 16
global cnt ulong 64
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emiti writes a signed n; the magnitude is taken as a ulong so the minimum long cannot overflow
fn emiti n long to void
if lt n 0
emit minus
emitu add bitcast ulong not n 1
else
emitu ulong n
end
end
note parse reads the decimal numbers in s (separated by spaces, an optional - sign) into vals and
note returns how many; one pass over s, so the loop is bounded by len s
fn parse s view uchar * to ulong
n = ulong 0
v = long 0
sg = long 1
dig = false
for i ulong len s
c = get s i
if eq c 45
sg = long -1
else
if and ge c 48 le c 57
v = add mul v 10 long sub c 48
dig = true
else
if dig
put vals n mul sg v
n = add n 1
end
v = long 0
sg = long 1
dig = false
end
end
end
if dig
put vals n mul sg v
n = add n 1
end
ret n
end
note show writes vals[0..n-1] separated by spaces, then a newline
fn show n ulong to void
for i ulong n
if gt i 0
emit sp
end
emiti get vals i
end
emit nl
end
note cntsort counts each value in min..max (the range must fit the 64 counters), then rewrites vals
fn cntsort n ulong to void
lo = get vals 0
hi = get vals 0
for i ulong n
if lt get vals i lo
lo = get vals i
end
if gt get vals i hi
hi = get vals i
end
end
for i ulong n
c = ulong sub get vals i lo
put cnt c add get cnt c 1
end
k = ulong 0
for x ulong add ulong sub hi lo 1
for y ulong get cnt x
put vals k add lo long x
k = add k 1
end
end
end
fn main to int
n = parse data
show n
cntsort n
show n
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
7 -3 12 0 7 4 -3 9 15 1 -5 4 12 0 8
-5 -3 -3 0 0 1 4 4 7 7 8 9 12 12 15
</pre>
